$ cat ws/.acme.json
{"version": 1, "strict": false, "plans": {"api": {"enabled": false}, "web": {"enabled": true}}}
$ acme --chdir ws/svc/store plans
api: disabled
web: enabled
[exit 0]

$ cat ws/.acme.json
{"version": 1, "strict": false, "plans": {"api": {"enabled": false}, "web": {"enabled": true}}}
$ acme --chdir ws/svc/store --flag-debug plans
  OPTION    VALUE            SOURCE
  --chdir   "ws/svc/store"   flag --chdir
  --config  "ws/.acme.json"  located
  --strict  false            key strict of ws/.acme.json
api: disabled
web: enabled
[exit 0]

# The workspace file sets the option strict.
$ cat strict/.acme.json
{"version": 1, "strict": true, "plans": {"api": {"enabled": false}}}
$ acme --chdir strict plans
acme: main: a disabled plan: api
[exit 1]

$ cat strict/.acme.json
{"version": 1, "strict": true, "plans": {"api": {"enabled": false}}}
$ acme --chdir strict --strict=false plans
api: disabled
[exit 0]

# The search stops at the directory with .git.
$ cat repo/.git
$ acme --chdir repo/pkg plans
acme: main: no workspace file
[exit 1]

$ cat typo/.acme.json
{"version": 1, "strickt": true}
$ acme --chdir typo plans
acme: plans: unknown key strickt in typo/.acme.json (did you mean strict?)
[exit 2]

# A path of the flag --config needs no search.
$ cat .acme.json
{"version": 1, "plans": {"root": {"enabled": true}}}
$ acme -c .acme.json plans
root: enabled
[exit 0]
